why: Both analyses land on the key's hedgehog, brutal facts and the refuse-the-merger/PBM-and-fix-quality decision, but Analysis 2 explicitly recognises Marbury as already great and frames its advice as stewardship and temptations to refuse, with a tighter one-screen verdict. Analysis 1 is slightly sharper on the streak-masking warning sign (EPS outpacing net earnings) but treats the company as merely good and prescribes more restructuring than the restraint the key calls for.
